about: North Glengarry is a township in the United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry, Ontario, centred on Alexandria and Maxville—not a city, and not South Glengarry on the St. Lawrence. Scottish Highland settlement, farmland, and village mains streets define the inland Glengarry countryside toward the Quebec border. About 10,000 people live in North Glengarry Township.
seoSummary: SDG township around Alexandria and Maxville—Highland Glengarry villages and farmland, not a city.
